latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the self-improvement logging skill for OpenClaw and generic agent workflows.

- Enables structured logging of errors, user corrections, learning, and feature requests via markdown files (`.learnings/LEARNINGS.md`, `ERRORS.md`, `FEATURE_REQUESTS.md`).
- Provides clear quick-reference table for when and how to log learnings, including categorization and escalation guidance.
- Outlines promotion of important learnings to project memory files (e.g., `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`).
- Includes setup instructions for OpenClaw integration (workspace structure, automated hooks) and generic agents.
- Defines standardized templates for logging learnings, errors, and feature requests with metadata and resolution tracking.
- Facilitates inter-session sharing and promotion of broadly applicable knowledge within agent environments.
